evals.name: python-openai-sdk
evals.prompt: I have a small order-support agent in this repo (agent.py, plain OpenAI SDK, Python). Connect it to AgentScore so its traces show up there. Our AgentScore ingest URL is https://agent-score-ingest.product.tricentis.com.
evals.expected_output: Bootstrap file + one import, OpenInference OpenAI instrumentor, hand-written invoke_agent root span and execute_tool span (plain SDK loop), env placeholders, .env git-ignored, manifest updated, one exported trace passing every span check.

evals.name: langgraph-agent
evals.prompt: This repo is a LangGraph support agent (main.py, uv project). Get it sending traces to AgentScore. Our AgentScore ingest URL is https://agent-score-ingest.product.tricentis.com.
evals.expected_output: uv add of OpenTelemetry + openinference-instrumentation-langchain, bootstrap + one import line, no manual spans (framework traces itself), one exported trace with agent, LLM and tool spans.

evals.name: node-vercel-ai-sdk
evals.prompt: This is a TypeScript agent on the Vercel AI SDK (src/agent.ts, npm). I want its traces in AgentScore. Our AgentScore ingest URL is https://agent-score-ingest.product.tricentis.com.
evals.expected_output: npm install of OpenTelemetry + @arizeai/openinference-vercel@2, bootstrap with OpenInference processor, experimental_telemetry enabled on the generateText call, one exported trace with agent, LLM and tool spans.

assertions: Programmatic: see grade.py (16-17 outcome-first checks per run).
